preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 3 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges, which is either n(n - 1) / 2 or 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The graph does not contain any loops or parallel edges.
preconditions.description: Each edge is a simple edge connecting two distinct vertices.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of edges to be added is non-negative.
The number of ways to add the edges is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: t == 0 if there exists an odd-length cycle in the graph
postconditions.description: If there is already an odd-length cycle, no edges need to be added.

postconditions.expression: t == 1 and w == 2 if there exists an odd-length cycle with two vertices, and adding one edge to complete the cycle is the only way to form an odd-length cycle.
postconditions.description: If there is an odd-length cycle with two vertices, adding one edge to complete the cycle is the only way to form an odd-length cycle.

postconditions.expression: t == 3 and w == 1 if the graph is a triangle (3 vertices and 3 edges), and adding one edge to form an odd-length cycle.
postconditions.description: If the graph is a triangle, adding one edge to form an odd-length cycle is the only way to form an odd-length cycle.

postconditions.expression: t == 1 and w == m if the graph is a path with n vertices, and adding one edge to form an odd-length cycle.
postconditions.description: If the graph is a path with n vertices, adding one edge to form an odd-length cycle is the only way to form an odd-length cycle.

postconditions.expression: t == 2 and w == (n * (n - 1) / 2 - m) * (n - 2) if the graph is a star with n vertices, and adding two edges to form an odd-length cycle.
postconditions.description: If the graph is a star with n vertices, adding two edges to form an odd-length cycle is the only way to form an odd-length cycle.
